content:
You are visiting San Francisco for the day and want to meet as many friends as possible. Solve the problem by considering various different schedules and picking the best one to optimize your goals.

Travel distances (in minutes):
Sunset District to Alamo Square: 17.
Sunset District to Russian Hill: 24.
Sunset District to Presidio: 16.
Sunset District to Financial District: 30.
Alamo Square to Sunset District: 16.
Alamo Square to Russian Hill: 13.
Alamo Square to Presidio: 18.
Alamo Square to Financial District: 17.
Russian Hill to Sunset District: 23.
Russian Hill to Alamo Square: 15.
Russian Hill to Presidio: 14.
Russian Hill to Financial District: 11.
Presidio to Sunset District: 15.
Presidio to Alamo Square: 18.
Presidio to Russian Hill: 14.
Presidio to Financial District: 23.
Financial District to Sunset District: 31.
Financial District to Alamo Square: 17.
Financial District to Russian Hill: 10.
Financial District to Presidio: 22.

CONSTRAINTS: You arrive at Sunset District at 9:00AM. Kevin will be at Alamo Square from 8:15AM to 9:30PM. You'd like to meet Kevin for a minimum of 75 minutes. Kimberly will be at Russian Hill from 8:45AM to 12:30PM. You'd like to meet Kimberly for a minimum of 30 minutes. Joseph will be at Presidio from 6:30PM to 7:15PM. You'd like to meet Joseph for a minimum of 45 minutes. Thomas will be at Financial District from 7:00PM to 9:45PM. You'd like to meet Thomas for a minimum of 45 minutes.

Your response should start with 'SOLUTION:'.

Please output the meeting schedule in the following JSON format:
{"itinerary": [{"action": "meet", "person": "<PERSON_NAME>", "start_time": "<HH:MM>", "end_time": "<HH:MM>"}]}. Make sure to include the person's name for each meeting.

SOLUTION:
I have created an optimal schedule that allows you to meet all four friends while respecting the minimum meeting times and travel constraints. Starting from Sunset District at 9:00 AM, the schedule minimizes total travel time by meeting Kevin and Kimberly in the morning, followed by Joseph and Thomas in the evening. The travel times between locations are accounted for in the gaps between meetings.

- First, go to Alamo Square to meet Kevin. Travel time is 17 minutes, arriving at 9:17 AM. Meet for the minimum 75 minutes, ending at 10:32 AM.
- Next, go to Russian Hill to meet Kimberly. Travel time is 13 minutes, arriving at 10:45 AM. Meet for the minimum 30 minutes, ending at 11:15 AM.
- After Kimberly, you have free time until the evening. Position yourself to arrive at Presidio by 6:30 PM for Joseph. Travel from Russian Hill to Presidio takes 14 minutes, so depart Russian Hill by 6:16 PM to arrive on time.
- Meet Joseph at Presidio from 6:30 PM to 7:15 PM (exactly 45 minutes, as required by the tight window).
- Finally, go to Financial District to meet Thomas. Travel time is 23 minutes, arriving at 7:38 PM. Meet for the minimum 45 minutes, ending at 8:23 PM.

This schedule meets all minimum time requirements and ensures you arrive at each location within the friends' availability windows. Total travel time is 67 minutes (S to A: 17 min, A to R: 13 min, R to P: 14 min, P to F: 23 min).

The itinerary in JSON format includes only the meeting actions, as specified.

{"itinerary": [{"action": "meet", "person": "Kevin", "start_time": "9:17AM", "end_time": "10:32AM"}, {"action": "meet", "person": "Kimberly", "start_time": "10:45AM", "end_time": "11:15AM"}, {"action": "meet", "person": "Joseph", "start_time": "6:30PM", "end_time": "7:15PM"}, {"action": "meet", "person": "Thomas", "start_time": "7:38PM", "end_time": "8:23PM"}]}
